title: Handle change notices
summary: A quiet line in a chat when a member set, changed or removed their @ (ADR 0066). People see that the @ changed, so a scammer cannot take over a familiar @ unnoticed.

name.description: The member's display name in this chat.

old.description: The @ before, without @. Absent for a first set.

new.description: The @ after, without @. Absent for a removal.

of.description: One line, placed by time between the loaded timeline items.

lines.description: Changes of current members after they joined, from POST /v1/handle-changes.

refresh.effect: When the chat opens and on foreground: POST /v1/handle-changes for the members (at most 100 per call, since the last check) and caches the answer on the phone.

place.effect: On each timeline update: inserts the lines between the items by time. A change older than the first loaded item waits for back-pagination; a newer one shows at the end only when the timeline is live.

notes: The lines are local items made by the app, not Matrix events. They have no actions.
bipe_handle_set: %1$s name, %2$s new. bipe_handle_changed: name, new, old. bipe_handle_removed: name, old.
Bipe logic: BipeHandleChange.line, BipeHandleChange.placements, BipeHandleChangeStore (iOS); BipeHandleChanges, BipeHandleChangeLine (Android). Move them; the placement rules are tested there.
